name: JW Marriott Edmonton ICE Disctrict
positioning: JW Marriott Edmonton ICE District: a luxury hotel connected to Rogers Place in the heart of ICE District, with Alberta-inspired design, Spa by JW and the Archetype fitness and recovery club
best_for: Hockey and concert fans who want to be connected to Rogers Place
Wellness-minded city travelers who want a full-service spa and a serious fitness club on site

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of ICE District, Canada's largest mixed-use sports and entertainment district.
The Royal Alberta Museum, Art Gallery of Alberta, Winspear Centre, City Hall and Citadel Theatre are just steps away.
The hotel is steps from the River Valley trail system.
The custom furnishings and design elements are inspired by the natural beauty of Alberta.
Rooms feature marble bathrooms and custom artwork.
The hotel has a 22nd-floor Executive Lounge.
Spa by JW offers massage therapies, facials and restorative rituals.
Spa by JW offers Sacred Moments for Two, which begins with aromatic foot rituals and ends with synchronized massages.
Archetype has four purpose-built studios for Yoga, HIIT, Spin and Boxing.
Archetype's Regeneration Lab features compression therapy, meditation pods, red light therapy and steam rooms.
Braven Restaurant pairs fine dining with an Alberta steakhouse, serving dry-aged steaks and wood-fired favorites.
Alchemy Bar has a heated fifth-floor patio.

highlights.text: The hotel is connected to Rogers Place in Edmonton.
Archetype, on the hotel's 5th floor, is a high-performance fitness and recovery club.
Spa by JW is a full-service spa with five treatment rooms.
An above-ground pedway connects the hotel to downtown Edmonton's Arts District.
Le Petit Chef is an immersive dinner where a tiny animated chef appears on the table through 3D projection mapping.

considerations.text: Parking is valet; oversize parking is not guaranteed and is offsite.
WhataHotel notes the downtown location may bring city noise.
